story.title: SEBI Orders Immediate Cybersecurity Overhaul Across All Regulated Entities, Citing Claude Mythos Risks
story.summary: India's Securities and Exchange Board of India has issued a formal cybersecurity circular naming Anthropic's Claude Mythos AI system as a specific threat, ordering every regulated financial entity to urgently strengthen its cyber defences. SEBI has also formed a dedicated task force to oversee the overhaul. This is the first time SEBI has named a specific AI capability in a regulatory circular, marking a significant escalation in how Indian financial regulators treat advanced AI as a systemic risk.
use_cases: AI risk classification by financial regulators
cyber defence mandates for banks and brokerages
